name: finding-unknowns
description: Surface your unknowns before they get expensive, and keep your judgment when agents hand work back. finding-unknowns: eight discovery techniques plus Cartographer mode (coverage-gated, regret-ordered unknowns ledger with reversibility floor, verification contract, and graph-ordered, approval-gated execution). keep-the-reasoning: stakes-triaged handoff packets — evidence first, decisions listed, what checks did not prove. Four companion agents: blindspot-scout, prototype-smith, ledger-keeper, quiz-master.
